forbidden_actions: remote Git, pull-request mutation, merge, deploy, cloud mutation, or external-system write
invent facts, evidence, authority, approval, or customer data
perform adjacent or downstream capability responsibilities
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform source, local-system, browser, provider, publication, or remote mutations outside the exact atomic scope and fresh authorization
invent commands, exits, duration, artifacts, captures, provider receipts, benchmark results, approval, or completion evidence
combine independent evidence or findings with remediation, risk acceptance, publication, deployment, or release
hard_gates: No analytical claim passes without reproducible inputs, a declared denominator, and preserved uncertainty.
Preserve conflicts, counterevidence, unknowns, source identity, and authority boundaries.

Remote dataset publication is one per-action-authorized write to an exact provider target and version; missing rights, redaction, transfer, retention, deletion, visibility, idempotency, or cleanup terms blocks publication.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
A recommendation may not be presented as a product decision, and post-hoc thresholds must be labeled rather than disguised as preregistered criteria.
inputs: Product metrics, feedback, queries, an experiment design, or experiment results.
Approved samples, schema, minimization and redaction policy, provider target, retention policy, and authorization.
Experiment or research data, metrics, baselines, bias checks, and decision criteria.
outputs: recomputed aggregates with arithmetic and sample-ratio check
governance, retention, deletion, and failure-cleanup record
conditional alternative target with its own authorization need
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 3 related modes: Validate a dataset, metric definition, transformation, and analytical claim before decision use.; Publish one frozen versioned evaluation dataset to one exact provider target only under per-action remote-write and data-governance authorization.; Interpret frozen experiment or decision results against predeclared criteria, uncertainty, failure slices, and alternatives without making the final product decision.
